description: Returns the status of a file uploaded through a PostWire upload link, by upload_id: "waiting" until the file has arrived, then "done" with its media_url (an https URL valid for 6 hours, renewed when the post goes out, that works as video_url or photo_url), kind (photo or video), size and content type.

upload_id.description: The upload_id returned with the upload link.

name: get_uploaded_file
title: Check an uploaded file
